title: GeoActivity Reload
description: General Information : This mod adds 3 new different coal ores to the game:
body:
The original author of the mod is decebaldecebal.
This is a new update from my side for updated versions.


**Description**
GeoActivity Reload - customizable tools/armor, ore quadrupling and much more.
![GeoActivity](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d0dd2036756becd5f5ac316f426de7e68c28f14.png)
Features

- 3 new coal types

- new armor/tools sets that can be customized

- new blocks

- new machines

General Information

This mod adds 3 new different coal ores to the game:

Anthracite Ore - spawns on layers 11 - 12, more difficult to find

Bituminous Ore - spawns on layers 0 - 63, not very hard to find

Lignite Ore - spawns on layer 0 - 136 , somewhat common

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/724f4121beef0216c1b6c9cef3269a0b0d5e4c3f.png)

 For the moment, this mod will be available in version 1.16.5, however I will update it frequently to add everything that the previous mod had.

The future version available will be 1.18.2.

If you want older versions like 1.7.2 or 1.10.2, visit the old page of the mod: GeoActivity - Minecraft Mods - CurseForge
